title: Real-time Scanning / Advance Threat Shield (HIPS): scan disagreement and missed detection

title: Advance Threat Shield / HIPS: self-protection gap
description: The sender says SiyanoAV files can be renamed or modified, indicating a self-protection concern relevant to Advance Threat Shield / HIPS. The report does not identify the exact process, file, privilege level, or tested product module.

description: Reported Privacy Firewall concerns include inaccurate status, unsuccessful Brave blocking, and application rules not being added automatically. A Windows Firewall comparison is reported as working; reproduction and effective-rule inspection are still required.

title: Browser Safety / Parental Control: whitelist and chat-category failures
description: Within the reported Browser Safety and Parental Control filtering experience, WhatsApp is reportedly treated as social media, whitelist tests fail, and a chat site remains reachable despite category filtering.

title: Browser Safety / Parental Control: incomplete web-category coverage

title: File handling / File Shredder-related workflows: restore and assessment defects
description: Reports cover quarantine restore scope, exception handling, Drive deletion, an add-folder crash, uninstall cleanup, and assessment-result mismatches. File Shredder is a related file-handling module to validate separately; no specific shredder defect is reported in the source pages.
